chunks: We have not created the heavens and the earth and all that lies between them out of play.
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran mean by creation not being 'out of play'?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Ad-Dukhan (44:38) is often linked with the preceding verse (44:37) to affirm that the cosmos was created for a serious purpose, specifically to test humanity and manifest divine attributes. This underscores the concept of 'Hikmah' (wisdom) in creation, rejecting the notion of arbitrary or playful existence, and reinforces the gravity of the Hereafter as the ultimate destination for this purposeful creation.
